{{Quote|The Naberrie family, one of the most honored families in Naboo history. Queen Padmé Amidala was a Naberrie, along with several former Senators and many high officials.|Lareen Dantara to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Lareen Dantara|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Naberrie family''', also known as '''House Naberrie''', was a prominent family from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], with many of its members being involved in public service. The most famous member was [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. In the last decades of the [[Old Republic era]], despite belonging to the nobility, the family lived very humbly in a small [[Unidentified Naboo mountain village (Padmé Amidala)/Legends|mountain village]].<ref name="Episode I: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

The family began with [[Winama Naberrie]], Padmé's grandmother by her father's side. Her son [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee]] married [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal Thule]], the daughter of [[Ryoo Thule]], and they had two girls, Padmé and [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]]. Sola married [[Darred Janren Naberrie|Darred Janren]] and had two children, [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo]] and [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja]]. After some discussion, Sola and Darred agreed to keep Naberrie the family name, so their daughters' last name was Naberrie. Padmé married the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and had twin children [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]].

The family produced two Galactic [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] that represented the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]: Padmé Amidala during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] era ([[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]) and Pooja Naberrie during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era ([[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]]&ndash;[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]).

The family was unaware that they were related to the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family]] through Padmé Amidala, whose marriage to Anakin Skywalker had been kept a secret, until around [[36 ABY]] when Leia Organa Solo met with Pooja Naberrie and revealed the relationship between the two families.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
